info.name: CLC CRM API
info.description:
Full API surface of the CLC / IDURAR-based CRM (MERN) — core auth, generic entity CRUD, sales/marketing/analytics, calling/call-center, LMS (Moodle + live classes + recordings + attendance), ads integrations (Facebook / Google / LinkedIn), Git, Vercel, and all webhooks.

## Setup
1. Set collection variable `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:8888`; VPS = `http://200.141.5.195`).
2. Run **Auth → Login** then **Auth → Verify OTP** — the OTP-verify request auto-saves the JWT into `{{token}}`.
3. All `/api/*` requests (except the webhook folders and Public) send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from the collection auth.

## Generic CRUD
Every Mongoose entity is exposed through the same 9 routes. Use the **Generic Entity CRUD** folder and set `{{entity}}` (e.g. `lead`, `course`, `batch`, `salesdeal`). Full entity list is in that folder's description.

item.name: Generic Entity CRUD
item.description:
Every Mongoose entity uses these 9 routes. Set the collection variable `{{entity}}` to one of:

`agentcallstate, announcement, appraisal, approval, attendancerecord, batch, call, callcallback, callcampaign, calllead, callrecord, campaign, candidate, captureformconfig, certificate, client, course, emailbroadcast, employee, exitrecord, expenseclaim, facebookad, facebookadcreative, facebookadset, facebookcampaign, facebookconnection, facebookwebhooklog, gitconnection, googlead, googleadgroup, googlecampaign, googleconnection, googlewebhooklog, holiday, hrasset, hrattendance, hrdocument, hronboarding, hrticket, invoice, ivrflow, journey, lead, leadimportbatch, leaverequest, linkedincampaign, linkedincampaigngroup, linkedinconnection, linkedincreative, linkedinleadsynclog, liveclass, liverecording, lmsenrolment, lmslivesession, lmssetting, lmssyncjob, lmswebhookevent, loanadvance, loginactivity, marketingmetric, message, messengerbroadcast, messengercontact, messengerconversation, moodleobjectmap, moodleusermap, notification, opsdelivery, opsdocument, opsproject, payment, payslip, permission, product, recognition, salescost, salesdeal, salesorder, salesquote, segment, shift, shiftroster, student, team, telephonyevent, ticket, timesheet, trainingprogram, vendor, vercelconnection`

List/search accept `?page`, `?items`, `?q`, `?fields`, `?sortBy`, `?sortValue`. Filter accepts `?filter=<field>&equal=<value>`.

item.name: LMS — Live Classes
item.description: Both `/liveclasses` and `/live-classes` resolve to the same handlers. `POST /:id/join` also has `/join/teacher` and `/join/student` aliases.

request.description: Set or change a class's scheduled start + duration. Only the class teacher (or a manager) and only while the class is SCHEDULED / UPCOMING. autoStartAt=true makes the lifecycle tick auto-start it at that time. The meeting link never changes.

item.name: Add student to a running batch (manager / batch teacher)

request.description: Enrol a student into a batch mid-course. Creates the Student roster row, best-effort Moodle provision + enrol, and emails them the SAME persistent class link + schedule. They then appear in every upcoming class of the batch. Body: { email, name } or { crmUserId }.

item.name: Pilot — SSO link for any user

query.description: short-lived JWT (JWT_SECRET) identifying the CRM user — from an emailed / shared class link

request.description: Pre-bearer. A plain browser hitting a bearer-gated /api/lms/... URL used to show raw {"jwtExpired":true} JSON. This endpoint verifies ?t= as a JWT, issues a one-time join ticket and 302-redirects to the meeting — or, if the token is missing/expired, returns a friendly HTML page with a button back into the app (#/lms/classes).

item.name: Telephony webhooks (VPS → CRM, HMAC)
item.description: Mounted at /api/telephony BEFORE the bearer gate. Every request is HMAC-signed (headers x-telephony-key / -timestamp / -nonce / -signature) — not a CRM login. signature = HMAC_SHA256(`${timestamp}.${nonce}.${rawBody}`, TELEPHONY_WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET).
